You must submit the pre-enrolment application on the Universitaly platform (www.universitaly.it) and then contact the Italian embassy in your country, which will issue you with the entry visa to enter Italy for study purposes and fall within the places reserved for non-EU citizens.
The pre-enrollment application on Universitaly is mandatory for all non-EU applicants not residing in Italy (including those holding a residence permit for other EU countries).

Mandatory documents to be uploaded during pre-enrollment procedures on Universitaly: Passport Photo Admission letter (if provided) High-school diploma (for enrollment in Bachelor's Degree programmes) / Bachelor's Degree + Transcript of exams (for enrollment in Master's Degree programmes)

notes: Tuition left out: the pages give no single EUR amount for a full-time Bachelor student from outside the EU living abroad; the fee pages are ISEE-band simulators and international-student fee pages that state no amount.
